# Module: marketing and social copy

Load only for social posts, newsletters, launch and marketing copy.

Tags: strength (`hard` always · `default` unless an exception or the sensitivity says otherwise · `soft` preference) · kind (`ai-tell`, `clarity`, `both`, `procedure`).

### LEX-043 · social-media register props
`default · ai-tell · scope: prose · voice can override`

In social and newsletter writing, cut empty endorsement sign-offs, 'worth X-ing' without a reason, fake-casual props and announcement formulas (thrilled to announce, hot take, chef's kiss).

- Threshold: **standard:** any endorsement or announcement formula; casual props at 2+ per piece · **strict:** any single occurrence · **relaxed:** endorsements without a reason only
- Triggers: `this one is worth your time`, `must-read`, `i highly recommend giving this a read`, `do yourself a favor and read this`, `you won't want to miss this one`, `save this for later`, `bookmark this`, `don't sleep on this one`, `thank me later`, `worth reading`, `worth paying attention to`, `worth a look`, `worth exploring`, `worth checking out`, `worth your time`, `*checks notes*`, `*chef's kiss*`, `*mic drop*`, `*takes a deep breath*`, `*sips coffee*`, `(yes, really)`, `(no, seriously)`, `hot take`, `fun fact`, `pro tip`, `psa`, `unpopular opinion`, `because of course it does`, `thrilled to announce`, `excited to share`, `humbled to announce`, `humbled to share`
- Exceptions: the reason is stated in the same sentence; the writer's own established voice (casual props are style, not integrity)
- Example: ✗ Thrilled to announce v3! Must-read changelog, worth your time. → ✓ v3 is out: imports are 4x faster and the CLI has a dry-run flag.
